subject: Sorry about the missing sheet
text:
Hi, I think I forgot to attach the budget sheet you asked about. Sorry! Before you send it to the council, it's worth adding the dates next to each figure, because they'll probably want to match invoices with the repair window. You don't need to overhaul everything, just a few lines so it reads clearly. If you want, I can skim it once and tell you where it feels too cramped. Happy to help, and apologies again for the missing file, much appreciated.

Best,
